title: Retained power law
material_novelty: Combines a signed retained-share transition with inverse-power benefit and literal epoch damage; this synthesis was not evaluated as one form in the historical registry.
evidence: Best current WSD80 code-target geometry, but it has not cleared the high-TPP 300M selection gate and invents phase gains on broad-text targets.
reopen_condition: Retain only as the parent for nested ablations; promotion still requires the charter gates.

title: Hierarchical amplitude pooling
material_novelty: Changes partial pooling of linear response amplitudes, not the latent state or transition law.
evidence: Heldout error improved while 39-bucket OOF error was essentially unchanged.
reopen_condition: Reopen only as an estimator comparison under common rows and folds.

title: Marginal-value ordering block
material_novelty: Uses analytic derivatives of the RPL benefit and damage response instead of a free phase head.
evidence: Improved WSD80 fit but did not carry phase-gain geometry without the retention transition.
reopen_condition: Retest only as a nested component of a materially new transition.

title: Signed retained-state and response repairs
material_novelty: Makes the retention gate tied-neutral, permits signed even response, and includes benefit and damage derivatives. These repair the RPL implementation rather than add a new mechanism.
evidence: Removed tied-channel contamination and improved WSD80 geometry; later smooth signed-column repairs supersede the original implementation.
reopen_condition: Use the repaired form as the RPL parent.

title: Gradient-tied aggregate control
material_novelty: Shares the independently fitted aggregate response with a first-order contrast derivative and Fisher-quadratic cost.
evidence: Joint fitting rewrote the aggregate channel; staged fitting preserved it but missed WSD80 phase magnitude and failed 300M transfer.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with a new aggregate-conditioned state or identification equation, not a free multiplier.

title: Continuous-time retained-state transition
material_novelty: Grafts an exact acquisition-and-forgetting ODE onto RPL's power-law response. The response graft is new, but the transition mechanism is a prior-route reopening.
evidence: Distorted the WSD80 tied response by 14.4-16.4 seed SD and moved the optimum farther from the observed policy.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with a materially different state transition and an outcome-free explanation for the prior StarCoder shape failures.

title: Phase-local repetition and replay
material_novelty: Tests phase-local replay damage and Jensen excess inside RPL. The factorization is new; unique coverage, collision, replay forgetting, and Jensen acquisition are exposed mechanisms.
evidence: The only local gain was nearly collinear with concentration and worsened frozen heldout regret and lower-tail optimism.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with a new measured replay state or cross-scale invariant that distinguishes the exposed mechanisms.

title: Aggregate-conditioned replay control
material_novelty: Separates a tied aggregate backbone from gradient transport, Fisher phase information, and replay Jensen cost on exact aggregate-matched pairs.
evidence: Positive replay taper exponents worsened both 300M targets and WSD80; generic even costs were collinear. Fisher was later identified as route prior_AB's local form.
reopen_condition: Do not retune the same coordinates; require a new transition state or response invariant.

title: Aggregate-Hessian phase control
material_novelty: Uses the tied response Hessian as a nonnegative contrast cost with one amplitude.
evidence: Worsened 300M Uncheatable asymmetric RMSE and selected the wrong WSD80 boundary with severe optimism.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with noncommuting or state-dependent curvature that is distinguishable before outcome fitting.

title: Late-reactivation control
material_novelty: Models recovery when a bucket absent early reappears late; unlike a phase multiplier, the state is activated by an omission/reactivation event.
evidence: The one-sided state improved one edge but moved error to the opposite edge and did not clear the high-TPP gate.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with a two-sided omission and reactivation transition justified independently of residuals.

title: Compact retained-state aggregate backbone
material_novelty: Tests an existing Compact Retained State restriction as the tied aggregate spine; it is not a new phase mechanism.
evidence: Its tied optima were overoptimistic and unstable across folds on both 300M targets.
reopen_condition: Reopen only after a materially new aggregate response link passes the tied gate.

title: Corpus-scaled inverse-power curvature
material_novelty: Makes inverse-power curvature depend on a physical corpus-size exposure scale.
evidence: Improved random WSD80 folds but failed coordinate-blocked fit and tied-optimum tolerance.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with a new corpus-scale state, not a wider exponent grid or free bucket exponents.

title: Pointwise-authority saturation
material_novelty: Bounds first-order aggregate-gradient transport by the local aggregate-response range.
evidence: The 300M design lacked two-sided support and operated almost entirely in the linear regime.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with an independently measured saturation scale and adequate support.

title: Phase-ordered concentration
material_novelty: Uses signed phase-local concentration at fixed aggregate, initially gated by aggregate-gradient magnitude.
evidence: The clean odd component lacked two-sided 300M support; its apparent balance came from an even term induced by unequal phase lengths.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with parity derived first and a new independent physical functional.

title: Fisher phase-information cost
material_novelty: No material novelty: this is the second-order Taylor approximation of the previously rejected phase-label Jensen-Shannon adaptation-debt route.
evidence: Historical transfer froze the base and found coefficient collapse; the current provenance audit blocked outcome fitting.
reopen_condition: Only a non-even switch-debt state or materially new identification argument can reopen this family.

title: Family-pooled retained response
material_novelty: Moves diminishing returns from bucketwise response to semantic-family totals while retaining bucket residuals.
evidence: Failed projection-independence and conditioning gates on the 300M design.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with a family partition and response coordinate that is identifiable outcome-free.

title: Centered hierarchical RPL
material_novelty: Centers bucket amplitudes on family means. This changes the coefficient prior, not the training dynamics.
evidence: Nested gains disappeared under pinned nonlinear configurations and did not improve both targets stably.
reopen_condition: Reopen only under a new, preregistered hierarchy with an independently justified covariance structure.

title: Signed family mediation
material_novelty: Conserves family-total contrast while replacing bucket contrast with a family-mediated component.
evidence: At full mediation it deleted most contrast norm, especially in the 31-bucket family, rather than sharing signal.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with a state transition that conserves both family totals and a calibrated contrast norm.

title: Coarse family churn
material_novelty: No material novelty in the one-family limit: the Hellinger churn hazard reduces to an exposed global divergence route.
evidence: Ninety-five percent of global Hellinger lay within the coarse partition and the feature was mostly explained by existing divergence and concentration coordinates.
reopen_condition: Require a within-family state that remains distinct after conditioning on global divergence.

title: Quality-pair churn
material_novelty: Refines Hellinger churn to predeclared high/low quality pairs; locally it is conditional Fisher geometry.
evidence: Residualized churn had the wrong sign and a bootstrap interval spanning zero on the frozen Stage-0 test.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with a directional transition that can introduce a new ordering direction.

title: Exact-pair channel weighting
material_novelty: Uses exact aggregate-matched difference equations to emphasize phase response without changing the RPL model.
evidence: Delta RMSE improved about 2 percent, but uncertainty included zero and Regret@1 worsened on both targets.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with a preregistered estimator whose covariance assumptions match the observed pair residuals.

title: Hierarchical retention random slopes
material_novelty: Adds centered within-family retention heterogeneity to RPL.
evidence: The design could not resolve 36 phase slopes at the required effect size, and the parameterization confounded heterogeneity with the shared rate.
reopen_condition: Require a low-dimensional transferable physical state rather than another bucketwise phase field.

title: Coverage-normalized epoch contrast
material_novelty: Normalizes phase contrast by physical corpus traversal without adding fitted parameters.
evidence: It changed gate scale by 2.5x-905x without a scale-matched arm and conflicted with the fixed-epoch WSD80 token ladder.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with a scale-identified contrast law and matched gate-steepness ablation.

title: Aggregate-gradient plasticity
material_novelty: Gates retained phase control by distance from stationarity of the independently fitted tied response.
evidence: The scalar is a distance in two buckets but a boundary-dominated statistic in 39 buckets; it also omitted the damage derivative and coupled odd and even response.
reopen_condition: Require an aggregate state with the same physical meaning and scaling across both mandatory panels.
